summary: The registrant, Galiano Gold Inc., a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing a news release announcing the publication of its 2025 Sustainability Report. The report covers environmental, social, and governance performance for the company and its Asanko Gold Mine. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is disclosed. This is a routine disclosure of an annual sustainability report, with no deal terms, stakeholder changes, or event-driven catalyst. As a non-US issuer, Form 6-K is the equivalent of a voluntary current report on Form 8-K for domestic filers. There is no actionable special situation to monitor.
